tha-ap205:1.1: Kiṅkhaṇikapupphiya.] Kañcanagghiyasaṅkāso sabbaññū lokanāyako / odakaṃ daham oggayha sināyi lokanāyako. // //
tha-ap205:2.1: Paggayha kiṅkhaṇiṃ pupphaṃ Vipassissbāhiropayiṃ / udaggacitto sumano dipadindassa tādino. // //
tha-ap205:3.1: Ekanavute ito kappe yaṃ puppham abhipūjayiṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhapūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap205:4.1: Sattasattati kappamhi rājā Bhimaratho ahu / sattaratanasampanno cakkavattī mahabbalo. // //
tha-ap205:6.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Kiṅkhaṇikapupphiyo thero i. g. a-ti.
